The fix is to install DaVinci Resolve from the Blackmagic website. It's the same app, and it's also free:

1. Quit DaVinci Resolve.
2. Download it from blackmagicdesign.com (Support section).
3. Install it and open this app again.

You can keep or uninstall the App Store version, it doesn't matter.

Resolve is open, but it isn't accepting external scripts.

There's one setting to fix, and you only have to do it once:

1. In Resolve, open  Preferences  >  System  >  General.
2. Find  “External scripting using”  and set it to  “Local”.
3. Click Save, quit Resolve completely and open it again.

If it was already set to “Local”, quit Resolve completely and open it again: the scripting connection sometimes doesn't come up when Resolve starts together with the system.

— — —
There's a second way that doesn't depend on that setting, in case the first one gives you trouble: close this app and open it again (that puts the scripts in the Resolve menu), then run

    Workspace  >  Scripts  >  Utility  >  CineCaptions_Puente

Leave it running and the buttons work just the same.

textos.El Puente que está corriendo dentro de R:
The Bridge running inside Resolve is from an older version of the app.

Updating the app puts the new file in place, but the Bridge that was already running keeps the old code until you launch it again.

1. Close the Bridge's console window in Resolve.
2. Run it again:
       Workspace  >  Scripts  >  Utility  >  CineCaptions_Puente

(If it doesn't appear in the menu, quit Resolve completely and open it again first.)

textos.Para que todo el video no se vea igual p: So the whole video does not look the same, you can create up to 3 variants of the same style (another color, another position, another font). The first one carries just the name; the second and third carry the number at the end. The program groups them by that number: everything ending in 2 forms variant 2.
textos.Por eso cada variante necesita sus tres: That is why each variant needs its three blocks with the same number: if one is missing, that variant is not used. A number higher than 3 (for example “principal 4”) is ignored and the program warns you. The video blocks alternate the variants, or use a fixed one if you pick it in “Fixed on this style”.

textos.Suena en la PRIMERA palabra del video: u: Plays on the FIRST word of the video: an opening whoosh. Only once.
textos.Suena en la ÚLTIMA palabra del video: ba: Plays on the LAST word of the video: the energy drops to close. Only once.
textos.Suena en cada palabra que termina en «?»: Plays on every word that ends in “?”: the riser lifts the tension right before the answer.
textos.Suena en cada palabra que termina en «!»: Plays on every word that ends in “!”: a dry impact that underlines the emotion.
textos.Suena en cada palabra escrita en MAYÚSCU: Plays on every word written in CAPITALS (2 letters or more): the ones you shout or want to highlight.
textos.Suena en cada palabra que lleva un númer: Plays on every word that has a number (prices, years, percentages): the low hit underlines the figure.
textos.Primera palabra después de un silencio l: First word after a long silence.
textos.Suena en la palabra que llega después de: Plays on the word that arrives after more than 1.2 s of silence: it marks an abrupt change of topic.
Plays on the word that arrives after more than 0.6 s of silence: a soft change of topic. The long pause wins if it is on.
textos.Suena en las palabras que forman un bloq: Plays on the words that form a block by themselves on screen.
textos.Inicio de un bloque largo (≥ 7 palabras): Start of a long block (≥ 7 words)
textos.Suena en la primera palabra de un bloque: Plays on the first word of a block with 7 words or more: it warns that a long sentence is coming.
textos.Suena en una de cada 5 palabras, de form: Plays on one in every 5 words, regularly: it marks the rhythm even when nothing special happens.
textos.La palabra clave de los bloques completo: The key word of the full blocks.
textos.Suena en la palabra PRINCIPAL (la que va: Plays on the MAIN word (the big one) of blocks that carry all three lines: above, main and below.
textos.Al inicio de cada palabra: At the start of every word
textos.Suena en cada palabra. Los dos sonidos s: Plays on every word. The two sounds alternate; if they overlap, they move to another track.
textos.Un riser sube la tensión en el primer bl: A riser builds tension in the first block of the video. Change it or add another.
textos.Un boom cierra el video en el último blo: A boom closes the video in the last block. It picks at random between the two.
textos.Suena al inicio de CADA palabra, alterna: Plays at the start of EVERY word, alternating the two sounds below. If two fall together, the second moves to another track (SFX 2, SFX 3…) so they do not overlap.
textos.Suena UNA vez, en la primera palabra del: Plays ONCE, on the first word of the video (an opening riser). If there are two sounds, the first is used.
textos.Suena UNA vez, en la última palabra del: Plays ONCE, on the last word of the video (a closing hit). If there are two sounds, the first is used.

textos.Salen iconos animados cuando se dice una: Animated icons appear when a word you choose is said (click a pack to write them) and, if you want, also on important sentences: a number, a warning, a question or the hook.
textos.Whisper usa tu tarjeta NVIDIA si encuent: Whisper uses your NVIDIA card if it finds the CUDA libraries; if they are missing, the voice is transcribed on the CPU (much slower). “Repair GPU” uses the ones the Qwen engine already includes or downloads NVIDIA's official ones (≈1.3 GB).
textos.Efectos animados, emojis, vistas de los: Animated effects, emojis, pack previews and transcriptions are saved so they are not redone. Each one has a limit and the least used is deleted automatically; “Clean now” applies the limits right away. Everything is created again when needed.

textos.Un efecto suave en bucle sobre todo el v: A soft looping effect over the whole video, blended in “Screen” so it only adds light.
textos.Los últimos segundos con una invitación: The last seconds with an invitation to follow you: an animated button, your logo or an end screen, with its sound.
textos.Pon tus propios efectos: fuegos, destell: Use your own effects: fire, flashes, frames, animations… on the intro, on the cuts, over the whole video or on the words you choose.
textos.Una línea por palabra: «dinero = bolsa d: One line per word: “money = money bag”. You can paste the emoji or type its name in Spanish or English (“house = casa”). Words like money, house, fire or idea come preset; here you add yours or change one (a line “money =” with nothing after it removes it).
textos.Un video o animación tuyo (MOV o MP4, PN: A video or animation of yours (MOV or MP4, PNG, GIF, animated WebP or APNG) to put over the video. Effects on a black background (fire, dust, flashes) go in “Screen”; those with transparency (PNG, GIF, WebP, MOV with alpha) go in “Normal”.

textos.Cuánto se nota todo a la vez: cuántos co: How noticeable everything is at once: how many cuts and icons, and the strength of the zoom and shake.
textos.Se aplica al propio video con una compos: It is applied to the video itself with a Fusion composition: your color grade still counts and nothing is duplicated. Slow zoom all the time, shake on the sound hits and, if the video doesn't fill the frame, a blurred background.
textos.GO corta los silencios del video en Reso: GO cuts the silences of the video in Resolve (the parts with voice are joined together) BEFORE placing the captions, which then come out with the new timings. Only on the video you drop in Home: it never touches a timeline of yours.
textos.El zoom, el temblor y las transiciones q: The zoom, shake and transitions that move the video look approximate here; in Resolve they come out at full quality.
textos.Fondo desenfocado si el video no llena e: Blurred background if the video doesn't fill the frame
textos.El cuadro se lanza hacia ti con un desen: The frame rushes toward you with a radial blur right on the cut.
textos.El cuadro sale volando hacia un lado con: The frame flies off to one side with blur and the next one comes in from the other (whip pan).
textos.Los colores se separan y el cuadro vibra: The colors split and the frame vibrates for a moment on the cut.
textos.Partículas de polvo que flotan y brillan: Dust particles that float and glow a little, all video long.
textos.Un grano fino de cine encima de toda la: A fine cinema grain over the whole image.
textos.Un resplandor cálido que se mueve despac: A warm glow that moves slowly.
textos.Un botón animado «Sígueme para más» en l: An animated “Follow me for more” button in the last seconds.
textos.Tu logo que entra con un destello al fin: Your logo that comes in with a flash at the end.
textos.El video se oscurece y sale tu logo con: The video darkens and your logo appears with the invitation to follow you.
textos.Tomas de apoyo gratuitas de Pexels cuand: Free supporting shots from Pexels when you say concrete things (house, beach, car…). You need your free API key (get it at pexels.com/api). They go UNDER the captions and the original audio keeps playing.
textos.Efectos con movimiento en la página «Efe: Motion effects on the “Effects” page: slow zoom, shake on the sound hits, new transitions on the cuts (zoom blur, whip pan and RGB glitch) and a blurred background when the video doesn't fill the frame. They are applied to the video itself with Fusion, so your color grade still counts. There is an overall intensity and a 3-second preview.
textos.«Más efectos» (plegado en la página Efec: “More effects” (collapsed on the Effects page): numbers 1, 2, 3 when you list things, stickers on key words, hand-drawn underline or circle, dust, grain or soft light, your own effects (MOV, MP4, PNG, GIF or WebP) and an ending with your logo and its sound. They avoid the captions and the face.
textos.Quitar pausas: GO recorta los silencios: Remove pauses: GO cuts the silences from the video you drop in Home before placing the captions (which then come out with the new timings) and can alternate a zoom on every cut.
textos.Sonido extra: un sonido en cada transici: Extra sound: a sound on every transition, a riser and hit before the hook's key word, background music that lowers itself when you speak (with BPM detection to align its beat), evened-out sound volumes and emoji sounds that follow the sentence.
textos.B-roll opcional: tomas de apoyo gratuita: Optional B-roll: free supporting shots from Pexels on concrete words (house, beach, car…), under the captions. It needs your free API key.
textos.GO se puede pausar, cancelar y reanudar;: GO can be paused, cancelled and resumed; if the program closes halfway it offers to continue where it left off. It tells you the language it heard and lets you correct it, and it notifies you with a system notification when done. The News dialog now shows moving clips.
textos.Más rápido y robusto: reutiliza la trans: Faster and more robust: it reuses the transcription of a video already done, uses your graphics card for the voice (repaired from Settings), warns if Resolve is frozen and downloads resume if interrupted.
textos.Sonidos que acompañan a los efectos y un: Sounds that go with the effects and a background music that lowers itself when you speak (with a gap of silence before the hit on the key word).
textos.Un sonido en cada corte con transición: A sound on every cut with a transition
textos.Riser y golpe antes de la palabra clave: Riser and hit before the hook's key word
textos.Igualar el volumen de todos los sonidos: Even out the volume of all sounds
textos.Sonido de los emojis según la frase (pos: Emoji sounds that follow the sentence (positive or negative)
textos.Alinear el pulso de la música con el gol: Align the music's beat with the hit and the effects

textos.Nuevo: Tema 5 «Edición total». Lo edito: New: Theme 5 “Full edit”. I edit everything: word-by-word animated captions with a glowing gold keyword, counting numbers, the emoji floating in 3D, the keyword HUGE behind the person and phrases that sweep across the screen behind them, plus the whole PRO Edit (hook, motion graphics, B-roll, maps and sound).
textos.Animaciones con Remotion dentro del prog: Remotion animations built into the app: a map with the flag when you name a country and 100 templates for weddings, quinceañeras, events and photo sessions (“Hi friends!”, “The bride’s house”, “Save the date”, “Comment WEDDING”…) that appear on their own when you say them.
textos.Nuevo: Tema 5 «Edición total», con el si: New: Theme 5 “Full edit”, built on the viral-reels system from the “Edit VIRAL Reels with AI” course: small sans captions with the key phrase in an italic serif in the color that suits your video, the step indicator when you say “three mistakes… number one”, the “from beginner to pro” slider, paper scenes with numbers and icons, split screen with the person below and, now and then, the key phrase behind the person. All consistent, no emojis or glows.
textos.Tema 5: además de las escenas, una anima: Theme 5: besides the scenes, a small animation under the caption that goes with what you say (a country with its flag, “Hi friends!”, follow or comment, numbers, and the 3D emoji of the topic: wedding, party, coffee…). The local AI directs the scenes on any topic, the video is analysed to vary the style, and sound effects in every theme now always sit below the voice.
textos.Temas 1–4 se ven mejor sin tocar su dise: Themes 1–4 look better without changing their design: a soft backing behind the text on bright videos, the highlighted word in the colour that suits your video, the small animations under the caption, and never over a face (even without the PRO Edit).
textos.Nuevo: Tema 6 «Editorial», con el estilo: New: Theme 6 “Editorial”, in the style of editorial reels: captions in a thin serif with the key phrase large in lime or white, peach scenes with white cards that come in with a flash, the camera viewfinder over your face, the search bar with the word to comment, your profile with followers counting up and the team pill.
textos.Tema 5: el fondo en blanco y negro con t: Theme 5: a black-and-white background with you in color when you say something strong, an icon orbiting your head (behind and in front), the frozen sticker in the hook, your shadow over the word behind you, cards above your head (the country map, a chart of the % you say, the crossed-out phrase, the checklist), the end screen when you ask people to follow and zoom transitions on the cuts.
textos.Emojis animados (Noto de Google) en los: Animated emojis (Google Noto) in the companions and the orbit, 136 new sounds so they don’t repeat, a softer edge on the cut-out person and render cache turned on so the timeline plays smoothly.
textos.Edición elegante y cálida: captions en s: An elegant, warm edit: captions in a thin serif with the key phrase large in lime, peach scenes with white cards, a camera viewfinder, a search bar and a profile that counts up.

textos.Los videos bajados de Instagram, Pintere: Videos downloaded from Instagram, Pinterest or TikTok no longer render silent (their HE-AAC audio is converted to AAC automatically), the intro sound effects stay under your voice, and a false warning about unpositioned emojis is gone.

Videos downloaded from Instagram, Pinterest or TikTok no longer render silent (their HE-AAC audio is converted to AAC automatically), the intro sound effects stay under your voice, a false warning about unpositioned emojis is gone and, if Resolve freezes when GO starts, it is closed and reopened automatically.
textos.GO se repara solo: si Resolve se congela: GO repairs itself: if Resolve freezes, closes or crashes mid-job, CineCaptions force-closes it if needed, reopens it, rebuilds your project with the video and finishes without showing you the error (Windows and Mac, Studio and Free).
textos.Los emojis animados ya no pierden su ani: Animated emojis no longer lose their exit animation or show the “no size or position” warning.

textos.Nuevo kit de motion graphics con 23 dise: New motion graphics kit with 23 designs that don’t repeat from one video to the next: reasons list, mystery, hook wheel, card fan, numbered path, neon title, concept card and mixed typography.
textos.Regla oficial: ningún gráfico ni emoji t: Official rule: no graphic or emoji covers a face or a caption, and a final rectifier removes what overlaps: extra zooms, mid-video risers, effects on top of the PRO Edit and sounds that match nothing. Captions no longer have a shadow behind them.
textos.Suena la caja registradora cuando dices: A cash register plays when you say money, price, sales, millions…
textos.Suena un tic-tac de cronómetro cuando di: A stopwatch tick-tock plays when you say time, minutes, hours, clock…
textos.Suenan aplausos cuando dices felicidades: Applause plays when you say congratulations, bravo, success, we made it…
textos.Suena el «acierto» (✓) cuando dices corr: The "correct" sound (✓) plays when you say correct, exactly, perfect…
textos.Suena el «error» (✗) cuando dices error,: The "error" sound (✗) plays when you say error, false, incorrect, wrong…
textos.Suena el obturador cuando dices foto, cá: The shutter clicks when you say photo, camera, selfie…
textos.Suena un latido cuando dices corazón, ne: A heartbeat plays when you say heart, nerves, heartbeat…
textos.Suena un brillo de «idea» cuando dices i: An "idea" shimmer plays when you say idea, secret, trick, imagine…
textos.Suena una explosión cuando dices boom, e: An explosion plays when you say boom, explode, bomb…
textos.Suena la fiesta cuando dices fiesta, cel: Party sounds play when you say party, celebrate, birthday…
textos.Suenan fuegos artificiales cuando dices: Fireworks play when you say fireworks, pyrotechnics, rockets…
textos.Más de 320 sonidos nuevos: aplausos, ova: More than 320 new sounds: applause, cheering, fireworks, money, correct and wrong, time, camera, heartbeats, paper, memes, keyboard, nature, ambiences, party, cinematic, transitions, explosions, pops, intros and more whooshes, risers, hits, clicks and glitches.
textos.Sonido por tema: cuando dices dinero, ti: Sound by topic: when you say money, time, congratulations, correct, wrong, photo, heart, idea, boom, party or fireworks, the matching effect plays (Advanced mode, already on).
textos.La IA de texto usa siempre el modelo más: The text AI always uses the largest model you have downloaded.
textos.Cuatro motion graphics nuevos: recortes: Four new motion graphics: magazine cut-outs (more than 220 icons in halftone, color sticker or neon), the key word selected like on an iPhone, the calendar that tears off pages ("30 days") and the neon network with the consume → create switch.
textos.Diez escenas nuevas a pantalla completa: Ten new full-screen scenes that illustrate what you say: a pictogram character, an evidence board, a polaroid with a photo from your video, a notebook, a calendar, a glass icon, a chat, a magazine collage, a phone with your profile and scissors cutting clips. The AI picks them with variety in the PRO Edit of Themes 1 to 6, each with its own sound, and the captions move down while they show.
textos.La Edición PRO busca en internet fotos C: The PRO Edit searches the internet for LICENSED photos of what you say (puppies, food, the city, malnutrition…) and shows them as full-screen scenes with their credit; the Log gives you Google Images and Pinterest links for your video topic to get inspired. It can be turned off in the PRO Edit menu.
textos.Arreglo: los colores y los fotogramas de: Fix: the colors and frames of your own video now reach the motions and scenes of the PRO Edit.
textos.Edición PRO más coherente en los Temas 1: More coherent PRO Edit in Themes 1 to 6: scenes no longer cover your own B-roll or your posters, every icon matches what you say (no eye when you say goodbye, no chart for «100% free»), the calendar no longer shows another date and Theme 6 keeps its style.
textos.Resolve va fluido y ya no se cierra: las: Resolve plays smoothly and no longer closes: CineCaptions' AI frees the graphics card as soon as it finishes (it used to hold up to 15 GB while Resolve played) and titles, effects and motions are pre-rendered in the background.
textos.La IA de texto elige su tamaño según la: The text AI picks its size by the memory that is really free: with Resolve open it no longer hangs for 100 s and the motions come from the AI again.
textos.Todos los temas empiezan con el gancho:: Every theme starts with the hook: the first sentence goes BEHIND you (Magic Mask in Studio; in Free, the local AI cutout).
textos.Temas 1 a 4: también con la Edición PRO,: Themes 1 to 4: also with the PRO Edit, up to 3 animations below the captions. Theme 5: icons sit right under their caption and leave with it.
textos.Más fotos de internet con licencia: de l: More licensed internet photos: of the places you name and of many more topics (festival, concert, tournament, scholarship, business, talks…), spread across the video.
textos.Tema 3: un solo juego de colores en todo: Theme 3: a single set of colors across the whole video, like the reference.
textos.Inicio: «Refrescar» en vez de «Ver el Re: Home: «Refresh» instead of «View the Log» (leaves Home clean and with nothing running). If Resolve reopens without a timeline, GO opens your latest project and carries on.

textos.El «Control inteligente de aplicaciones»: Windows 11's Smart App Control won't load files from programs it doesn't know yet and that have no digital signature. It blocked a CineCaptions library (the one that reads the video), and without it GO can't work. It's not a virus or a damaged file.
textos.Abre Configuración > Privacidad y seguri: Open Settings > Privacy & security > Windows Security > App & browser control > Smart App Control settings and choose «Off».
textos.Ojo: Windows no deja volver a activarlo: Note: Windows won't let you turn it back on without reinstalling the system. If you'd rather not turn it off, use CineCaptions on another computer.
textos.Windows no dejó cargar una librería de C: Windows didn't let a CineCaptions library load
textos.Una librería del programa no cargó. En W: A program library didn't load. On Windows 11 the most common cause is Smart App Control or an antivirus blocking it (it's not a virus).
textos.Si tu Windows tiene el «Control intelige: If your Windows has Smart App Control on or in evaluation: Settings > Privacy & security > Windows Security > App & browser control > Smart App Control settings > «Off» (Windows won't let you turn it back on without reinstalling).
textos.Si usas un antivirus (Avast, AVG…), añad: If you use an antivirus (Avast, AVG…), add the CineCaptions folder to its exceptions: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\CineCaptions.
textos.Si sigue, reinstala CineCaptions con el: If it continues, reinstall CineCaptions with the latest installer.
textos.Una parte de CineCaptions no cargó al ab: Part of CineCaptions didn't load at startup
textos.Al abrirse, CineCaptions comprueba sus l: When it opens, CineCaptions checks its libraries and engines. This one didn't load or isn't the expected version: whatever depends on it may fail.
textos.Si se repite, reinstala CineCaptions con: If it happens again, reinstall CineCaptions with the latest installer (your settings are kept).
textos.Si sigue igual, pulsa «Copiar este error: If it stays the same, press «Copy this error» and send it to support.
textos.No pude lanzar el Puente desde el menú d: I couldn't launch the Bridge from the Resolve menu ({c}); trying the console.
textos.Ya no se usa PowerShell: lanzar el Puent: PowerShell is no longer used: launching the Bridge in Resolve Free, getting past the project screen, expanding the viewer and playback now go through Windows Accessibility from CineCaptions. Antivirus programs like Avast blocked PowerShell, and then GO couldn't place anything.
textos.Si Windows 11 («Control inteligente de a: If Windows 11 (Smart App Control) or an antivirus blocks a library, the «Bad Image» box no longer appears: the Log says what happened and how to fix it.
textos.Pulsar GO otra vez sobre el mismo timeli: Pressing GO again on the same timeline (same theme or another) now works: the playback GO leaves running was blocking Resolve and the next GO thought it was closed. Now it stops it first and, if Resolve doesn't answer, it reconnects on its own.
textos.CineCaptions se conecta solo con Resolve: CineCaptions connects to Resolve on its own when it opens and every few seconds (Studio through its connection, Free by launching the Bridge from the menu), on Windows and Mac. The status no longer says «closed» with Resolve open.
textos.En Resolve Studio nunca se lanza el Puen: In Resolve Studio the Bridge is never launched (it left it unresponsive) and the PRO Edit cuts out the person with the local AI on Studio too: Resolve's Magic Mask once made it close. Studio and Free do the same thing.
textos.Emojis con sentido: cada emoji va con su: Emojis that make sense: each emoji goes with its word (🎓 scholarship, 🏆 prizes, 🍽 food, 🆓 free…). And where the PRO Edit shows something, the theme's emoji turns off: one thing at a time next to the caption.
textos.El Registro enseña solo los errores (los: The Log shows only errors (warnings stay in the file).
textos.Si Windows bloquea CineCaptions al abrir: If Windows blocks CineCaptions when it opens (Smart App Control), it says so with the steps to fix it, without technical text.
textos.Detuve la reproducción de Resolve antes: I stopped Resolve playback before continuing ({r}).
textos.Resolve no contestaba: lo volví a conect: Resolve wasn't answering: I reconnected it and I'm continuing.
textos.Resolve Studio no contestó: no lanzo el: Resolve Studio didn't answer: I'm not launching the Bridge (it would block it); reconnecting its MCP.
textos.CineCaptions se conecta solo; si tarda,: CineCaptions connects on its own; if it takes long, Resolve is busy (playing or with a dialog open).
textos.{n} errores. Empieza por el más reciente: {n} errors. Start with the most recent.
textos.Windows bloqueó una parte de CineCaption:
Windows blocked part of CineCaptions with Smart App Control. It's not a virus or a damaged file: Windows 11 won't load programs without a digital signature that it doesn't know yet.

What to do: Settings > Privacy & security > Windows Security > App & browser control > Smart App Control settings > «Off». Then open CineCaptions again.
(Windows won't let you turn it back on without reinstalling the system.)
textos.Resolve abierto: se conecta solo: Resolve is open: it connects by itself
textos.Abre un proyecto: el Puente se lanza sol: Open a project: the Bridge starts by itself
textos.No pude lanzar el Puente en Resolve Free: I couldn't start the Bridge in Resolve Free: leave Resolve with a project open (not the project screen) and not playing, then press GO again.

textos.Los gráficos animados que la Edición PRO: The animated graphics the PRO Edit places over your video. In Automatic the AI picks the right one for each phrase; if you mark your own, the AI will use ONLY those.
textos.La Edición PRO está apagada: estos motio: The PRO Edit is off: these motions are used when you turn it on in Home.
textos.Ninguno marcado: la IA elige entre todos: None marked: the AI picks from all

textos.Edición PRO activa: ella pone la intro,: PRO Edit on: it handles the intro, the hook, the zooms and the graphics. The classic effects are only used without PRO.
textos.Un destello de luz con su sonido: sube e: A flash of light with its sound: the riser builds (its last 2 s) and, right at its peak, the flash covers the image and the frame releases with a zoom punch.
textos.Volver al sonido que trae el programa (l: Go back to the built-in sound (the last 2 seconds of the Viral Hooks Riser, ending at its peak).
textos.El cuadro se acerca mientras sube el ris: The frame pushes in while the riser builds and snaps back, with the flash, right at its peak.
textos.Cuántos de los cortes del video llevan t: How many of the video's cuts get a transition.
textos.Automático: el destello suena como el di: Automatic: the flash sounds like a camera shutter (Shuter 11 and 13) and the other transitions use a whoosh or a glitch. The click or the sound's peak lands right on the cut.
textos.Se aplica al propio video con una compos: It's applied to the video itself with a Fusion composition: your color grade still applies and nothing is duplicated. A slow zoom throughout and, if the video doesn't fill the frame, a blurred background.
textos.El cuadro crece poco a poco durante todo: The frame grows little by little throughout the video (sped up in the example).
textos.Si el video no llena el cuadro: If the video doesn't fill the frame
textos.Por ejemplo un video horizontal en un ti: For example a horizontal video in a vertical timeline.
textos.Los silencios se cortan y los tramos con: Silences are cut and the speaking parts are joined together (in the example, the red pauses in the timeline close up).
textos.Con las pausas quitadas, el cuadro se ac: With the pauses removed, the frame pushes in on every other section, so the jump cut looks intentional.
Black bars show at the top and bottom.
A blurred copy fills the frame.

textos.Simple: los sonidos de la introducción,: Simple: the sounds of the intro, the words and the ending. Emojis: every emoji and its sound, to change them one by one. PRO Edit: the sounds of its graphics.
textos.Cada palabra: suena una vez por cada pal: Every word: a sound for each word that comes in. Main only: it sounds only on the big word of each block and you choose which sound effect. None: words make no sound; the intro and the ending stay.
textos.Cada gráfico de la Edición PRO suena com: Every PRO Edit graphic sounds the way an editor would make it sound, always under your voice and without stepping on the caption sounds (the «Simple» ones still play with the text).

textos.Un whoosh cuando algo entra deslizando,: A whoosh when something slides in, spins or moves. Its peak lands on the fastest frame.
textos.Un toque, un clic o un pop cuando aparec: A tap, a click or a pop when an icon, a number or each point of a list appears.
textos.Antes de cada cambio grande (el gancho,: Before every big change (the hook, a scene) a riser builds and ends in a hit right on the cut.
textos.Resolve Free: GO con el video ya en el t: Resolve Free: GO with the video already in the timeline, or after changing theme, no longer fails. If the Bridge doesn't respond because Resolve is still playing, CineCaptions stops playback and relaunches it by itself.
textos.Efectos: un carrusel con los 147 motions: Effects: a carousel with the 147 PRO Edit motions. In Automatic the AI picks the right one; if you mark your own, the AI uses ONLY those. With PRO on, the classic effects (which don't apply with it) are folded away.
textos.Sonido: nueva pestaña «Edición PRO» para: Sound: a new «PRO Edit» tab to turn its sounds on, make them louder or softer and choose which ones play (movement, appearances, riser + hit), with an example of each.
textos.Ortografía: el corrector ya no marca ni: Spelling: the checker no longer flags or changes correct words («voy», «hay», «tiene»), fixes typical mistakes («aser», «kiero», «nesecito») also in GO without AI, and the PRO Edit graphics use the corrected text.
textos.Temas 5 y 6: el tema hace toda la edició: Themes 5 and 6: the theme does the whole edit (graphics, transitions and sound). From this page only «Remove pauses» and the motions above apply.
textos.«Visuales: no» en Inicio: los efectos vi: «Visuals: no» in Home: the visual effects are not applied. «Remove pauses» and «Extra sound» are.

textos.Tema 2: las líneas de los captions van p: Theme 2: the caption lines sit together (no gap between them) and the emoji goes on top, right next to the stack (also in Theme 3).
textos.Cuando un caption se mueve para no tapar: When a caption moves to avoid covering a face, its emoji moves with it: before, it was left far away or landed on top of the text.
